task_summary: Restructure Topology Matters manuscript for Genome Biology: reorder, split methods, integrate E2/E3/E5/E6, new figures, reconcile claims

steps.title: Workshop new title candidates
steps.description: Propose a shortlist of candidate titles reflecting the narrowed, discriminator-preferred conclusion and the broadened scope (multi-backbone, biological validation, disjoint-support). Discuss with user; pick one.

steps.title: Reconcile abstract to narrowed claims
steps.description: Rewrite the structured abstract (GB Background/Results/Conclusions) so it matches the revision conclusions: discriminator preferable at operating point, critic over-corrects; drop the 'critic yields superior mixing' framing. Show exact current->proposed for approval.

steps.title: Reorder to GB structure (methods last)
steps.description: Move Materials and Methods to the end (after Discussion/Conclusions), Nature/GB style. Keep Background(Intro)/Related Work up front, Results in the middle.

steps.title: Split scCRAFT-specific from general methods
steps.description: Separate the general adversarial-deconfounding framework (discriminator vs critic objective, evaluation) from scCRAFT-specific backbone details, mapping onto the authored-vs-upstream code split.

steps.title: Add per-architecture subsections
steps.description: Add Methods subsections for each of the 4 backbones (scCRAFT / scVI-NB / Gaussian / ZINB) describing how the two adversarial heads attach to each.

steps.title: Apply E0 notation fixes
steps.description: Fix the three flagged equations: NB inverse-dispersion theta (not r_g); cosine loss L2-normalization + cell indexing; discriminator single V-way CE (not per-batch head h_v). Show each current->proposed.

steps.title: Integrate E2 backbone-generalization results
steps.description: New Results subsection + figure (fig_E2_backbones) showing the critic-vs-discriminator trade-off holds on all 4 backbones; retires the single-backbone limitation.

steps.title: Integrate E3 external baselines
steps.description: New Results subsection + table/figure comparing Harmony/scVI/scANVI/Scanorama/unintegrated against both adversarial heads.

steps.title: Integrate E5 biological validation
steps.description: New Results subsection + figure (fig_E5_biology): per-cell-type purity, rare-cell retention, label-transfer; direct evidence of critic over-correction.

steps.title: Integrate E6 support-overlap + local/global
steps.description: Fold support-overlap (measured disjointness, sep 0.68-1.00) into the premise/setup and add the local-vs-global decomposition result addressing the local/global mismatch.

steps.title: Expand dataset scope to 8
steps.description: Update datasets table + text from 3 to 8 (add cross-species immune, sim1/sim2, 2 ATAC); update the E8 multibatch results with the full metric suite.

steps.title: Redraw architecture figure
steps.description: Redraw Figure 1 to show the multi-headed reference-based Wasserstein critic, gradient penalty, reference batch, and the discriminator-vs-critic swap on a fixed backbone; propose design for approval before rendering.

steps.title: Reconcile Discussion + add Conclusions
steps.description: Update Discussion to the narrowed conclusions (remove single-backbone limitation now addressed; keep barycenter/annealing future work) and add a separate Conclusions section (GB convention).

steps.title: Port to BMC/GB template + compile-check
steps.description: Once user provides bmcart.cls, port structure onto it (abstract macros, bibstyle, figure handling) and compile-check on the dsai cluster (texlive module). Commit to GitHub.

desired_outputs: Redrawn architecture figure (Figure 1) showing multi-headed reference critic + backbone swap
New Results subsections + figures for E2 (backbones), E3 (external baselines), E5 (biology), E6 (support-overlap/local-global)
Reconciled abstract + discussion + new Conclusions section matching narrowed critic-vs-discriminator conclusions
Notation fixes (NB theta, cosine L2-norm, discriminator V-way CE) per E0
Final port onto bmcart (BMC/GB) class once template provided, compile-checked on dsai cluster

feasibility.rationale: All revision data and figures already exist as artifacts; the work is editorial restructuring + integration. Two external dependencies: the BMC bmcart class (user will provide) and LaTeX compilation (available on the dsai cluster, not in-sandbox). Each manuscript edit will be shown as exact current->proposed text for approval before applying.
